value.rationale: A substantial new interval of 80 consecutive exact cases of a natural open BWT run-amplification problem is established with explicit replayable witnesses. The interval includes n=128 and n=160, not covered by the displayed prime-based constructions. This is a meaningful finite cutoff rather than a trivial one-case increment, and no infinite theorem is claimed.
